items.title: Broken Access Control
items.brief: A seller order-detail endpoint checks that you are a seller, but not that the order is yours. Read a competitor order.
items.start: Sign in to the shop as the seller staff of Harbor Crafts (the demo account of the lab).

write_up.vulnerable: Order lookup by order number only; no store-ownership check.
write_up.fix: Scope the lookup to the caller's store and test that a second tenant gets 403 or 404.

items.title: Cryptographic Failures
items.brief: Gift-card codes are derived from a predictable serial, so any card's code can be forged.
items.start: Sign in as the customer player (the demo account of the lab).
